Parent #21; M3 GitHub adapter contribution, opened/dispatched only after M2 Domain, API/ports and independent viewmodel are accepted and serially integrated with exact canonical CI. Read AGENTS/developmentInstructions, full #21/this Issue, accepted GitHub focused review #43, REFDES/API/MigrationMap/Slices/Verification/FindingDisposition, all relevant frozen 1.0.0 BCs/shared BoundaryTypes/BCFreeze, especially Application--GitHub GH1..GH8 and related Git/State-Application contracts, plus actual accepted Domain/API/ports.

Use codereview-21/layer-github and a dedicated worktree from accepted M2 kickoff. Legacy internal/github parent/client stays unchanged and must not be imported. No other adapters, State/View, coordinator, legacy migration, module/workflow/shared metadata/frozen contract edits, integration merge/product PR/tag/release. Master coordinates shared requirements and separate fresh reviewer.

Implement all four exact RemoteFacts methods and CreatePullRequest from accepted ports. ResolveRepository verifies and registers remote scope-to-locator association for this adapter lifetime; later calls reject unknown/foreign scopes instead of decoding opaque IDs into unchecked URLs. Explicit authenticated host remains fixed per request; remote-only browsing/fully specified PR creation needs no local checkout. Canonical identity and validated URLs agree, one terminal .git suffix normalization is deliberate, branch identity bytes and full OIDs remain exact. Preserve provider format capabilities without assuming Domain SHA256 support implies GitHub support. Handle rename/transfer as explicit association, fork/base/head/deleted/inaccessible/unknown endpoints without invented scope.

All observations, interval provenance, source versions, page/filter/order-bound cursors, limits and unknown/partial states follow GH3/GH4 and accepted values. Default100/max10 pages per refresh; no unbounded paginate or capped/failed-list absence claim. Distinguish exact duplicate facts from conflicting page observations, keep independently valid records with explicit diagnostics/completeness, preserve requested expectations on stale results. DTO parsing is strict/bounded/private; nested values and buffers copy, cache concurrency cannot mutate prior results.

CreatePullRequest uses exact qualified expected published endpoints, explicit host and literal title/body/draft/maintainer intent. Reobserve before submission; foreign host/missing/drifted endpoints refuse before sending. Use noninteractive gh api/GraphQL, never gh pr create behavior, local Git/push/fork/auth-login/auth-refresh/config writes. Server lacks atomic expected-OID creation: retain actual created identity and post-create drift. Implement all six creation alternatives, including response-lost/partial transport CreationIndeterminate and ExistingCandidate without causal adoption. No automatic replay, close/delete/edit/corrective push, ownership inference from equal text/current refs, or exactly-once remote claim. Application alone orchestrates reconciliation and publishes operation events.

Private command transport uses separate bounded machine stdout/stderr, explicit host/profile, noninteractive arguments and redacted diagnostics. Preserve started/reaped/cleanup-known facts, configured30s read/120s mutation and separate2s forced drain/join budgets. Windows/Linux/macOS actual command/cancel/resource evidence is required; a killed root cannot prove descendants or remote rollback. Keep known facts/effects/recovery with nonnil errors, own bounded reap/reconciliation after caller cancellation, no unbounded background queue or independent mutation retry. 403/429/rate/private404/protocol errors remain structured rather than guessed from localized prose.

Verification covers all V-GH-01..03 and relevant Domain/Git/App/Composition/Slice relationships at exact source. Controlled raw transport fixtures cover host/fork/same-name ambiguity, full/invalid OIDs, null/deleted endpoints, >100/capped/overlapping/conflicting pages, malformed individual records, exact expected head/base drift, server rejection versus lost response, existing candidates, creation followed by refresh failure, literal Unicode/metacharacter payload, stream separation/truncation and cancellation before/after submission. Use owned local fixtures with actual subprocess lifecycle tests; do not create live remote PRs merely for tests. Clearly separate fixtures from any authorized read-only live observation. All12 architecture/import/build selections and configured branch CI remain required.

Freeze/push exact worker HEAD with complete local/CI evidence and limits. Separate fresh reviewer reopens real code/tests/frozen authority, reproduces adverse and positive controls, records/corrects/re-reviews findings. Master integrates after accepted Git in M3 serial order Git→GitHub→Persistence→Discovery→Runtime, verifies exact integrated CI and records source/review/integration. No full Slice or baseline finding closure from this adapter alone. Insufficient frozen contracts require BC-CHANGE, never a local bypass.

Implementation evidence must map each layer-owned clause to actual source/tests/platforms. Dependent Application/State/View/full-stack portions remain explicit later gates; this does not waive any native requirement owned by this contribution. Master alone declares contribution/Slice completion from independent review and verified integration.
